name: Monasterio de Rodilla (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Monasterio de Rodilla (a castle on red above a flower on green).
history: Municipal flag of Monasterio de Rodilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Monasterio de Rodilla arms — castle above a flower
